# Dropper, phase 3 (splat fit, generated by make_dropper.py): run after p2 with --no-save.
select Hopper
scale 1 0.86 1
apply --scale
select Body
scale 1 0.86 1
apply --scale
select Gear
translate 0 0.045 0
select Coin
scale 1 1.5 1
translate 0 0 0.03
select Key
scale 1 1.4 1
select all
export dropper_splat.glb
